rule: Current measured sizes become the maximum allowed. Future changes must not grow a tracked artefact beyond its limit (plus tolerancePct). Lower limits as the refactor lands; raising one is a reviewed exception (see docs/SIZE_BUDGETS.md).

exceptions.reason: Reviewed exception for the compare confidence-tier and evidence-trace feature work. The tier chip (with colour-blind-safe glyphs), verdict-lead banner treatment, projects-list tier badge and shared print styles added ~18 KB emitted CSS; the governed competitor-decision ledger (33 approved decisions, ~15 K lines) embedded in the competitor-registry chunk added ~54 KB JS and raised total JS ~86 KB; the verdict-tier helper, chip plumbing, approved-ledger promotion wiring and strong-direction coupling fix added ~15 KB to the Compare page; the evidence-trace default-expand fix and typed-SKU deep-link helper added ~0.9 KB to ProjectDetailPage. Growth was minimised by extracting the chip (CompareConfidenceTier.tsx) and decision queue (CompetitorDecisionReviewQueue.tsx); the remaining weight is the Phase 2/4/7/8 extraction programme's target (see docs/SIZE_BUDGETS.md).
